forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -0,0 +1,27 @@
+---
+depends_on:
+- 01M4B3XTMZSS5T07B8HEZXK9ZH
+- 01M4B3XZ1QTBXDAFR0ZPWAFXGZ
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '9280'
+title: 'Derived fields: readiness, virtual tags, progress, times'
+---
+## What
+The fields that the projection calculates at read time. The basis is plan.md §5.3 steps 4 and 5, and §6.
+- `Sources/FoundationModelsKanban/Derived/Readiness.swift`: terminal column (max `order`), done, `ready` (all `dependsOn` targets done; an unknown or unresolved target counts as not done), `blockedBy`, `blocks`. A cycle from a merge: each task in it is blocked, and the walk stops at a visited task.
+- `Derived/VirtualTags.swift`: `READY`, `BLOCKED`, `BLOCKING` (port `virtual_tags.rs`), and `CONFLICT` (the body has a conflict block).
+- `Derived/Progress.swift`: count `- [ ]` / `- [x]` / `- [X]` lines in the body.
+- `Derived/Timeline.swift`: `started` (first move to a column that is not the first column, in the current order) and `completed` (time of the last move, only if the task is now in the terminal column). `Board.summary` counts.
+- Display rules for a broken merged state: a task in a tombstoned or missing column shows in the first column; a comment on a tombstoned task is hidden; two columns with the same `order` sort by slug; a deleted author resolves to the tombstone.
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] A task that depends on an unknown task is blocked.
+- [ ] A dependency cycle from a merge gives blocked tasks and no endless loop.
+- [ ] A new column with a larger `order` changes `completed` of the tasks in the old terminal column.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] `Tests/FoundationModelsKanbanTests/Derived/ReadinessTests.swift`, `VirtualTagsTests.swift` (ported), `ProgressTests.swift`, `TimelineTests.swift`, `BrokenMergeTests.swift`.
+- [ ] Run `swift test --filter Derived`; expect all pass.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass.
\ No newline at end of file
